name: feather-attn: FlashAttention forward + backward in Triton
bar: Forward and backward pass gradcheck vs SDPA; causal + GQA + variable length; >= 70% of FlashAttention-2 throughput on an RTX 4090 at seq 4k, bf16
metric: TFLOPs/s vs FA2 and SDPA across seq 512-16k, charted
deliverable: Public repo, pytest suite, benchmark chart, write-up: 'What it took to get within X% of FlashAttention-2'
roles: Anthropic/OpenAI performance + kernels engineer, inference engineer, Together/Fireworks/Baseten
upstream: Open a PR or a detailed issue to a kernel library (e.g. a missing feature or benchmark in flash-linear-attention / Liger-Kernel)

name: featherserve: an LLM inference engine from scratch
bar: Paged KV cache, continuous batching, chunked prefill, radix prefix cache, speculative decoding, CUDA graphs, OpenAI-compatible API; serves Qwen3-1.7B; >= 60% of vLLM throughput on the same GPU and workload
metric: Throughput, TTFT p50/p99, ITL vs vLLM and SGLang on ShareGPT-style and shared-prefix workloads
deliverable: Public repo, load-test harness, write-up with flame graphs explaining every gap to vLLM
roles: Inference engineer at labs, vLLM/SGLang ecosystem companies, Baseten/Modal/Fireworks
upstream: At least one merged PR to SGLang or vLLM (bug fix, benchmark, or small feature). Labs read these.

name: feathertrain: 4D-parallel training framework
bar: DP/FSDP + TP + PP (1F1B) + CP from scratch on torch.distributed; trains a ~1B model on 8 GPUs; loss matches single-GPU baseline; MFU reported and >= 35% on H100
metric: Scaling efficiency 1->2->4->8 GPUs, MFU, memory per GPU per strategy
deliverable: Public repo, scaling report, write-up: 'Every collective in a 4D-parallel step, measured'
roles: Pretraining / research engineer (scaling), ML infra at labs
upstream: PR to torchtitan or a detailed reproducible issue

name: Reasoning RL: reproduce and extend an R1-Zero style result
bar: Reproduce a published GRPO / Dr. GRPO number on a 1.5B model within the paper's error band, then one original ablation with 3+ seeds and CIs
metric: MATH/GSM8K accuracy vs steps, your curve overlaid on the paper's; ablation table
deliverable: Public repo + W&B report + write-up; the ablation is the original contribution
roles: Post-training / RL research engineer at Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, xAI, Meta; Anthropic Fellows
upstream: PR to TRL / verl / OpenRLHF if you hit a bug

name: Pretraining at speedrun quality
bar: Train GPT-2-small class model to the speedrun loss target; then one ablation (optimizer, attention variant, data) with a clean before/after under fixed compute
metric: Time/compute to target loss; ablation delta with seeds
deliverable: Write-up + logs; submit a record attempt or a documented negative result to modded-nanogpt

name: DeepSeek-V3 in miniature, with the 2026 ideas ablated
bar: A ~0.5-1B model with MLA + DeepSeekMoE (shared + fine-grained experts, aux-loss-free balancing) + MTP, trained FP8 on RunPod; then ablations of DSA, mHC and Engram under fixed compute, 3 seeds each, vs a dense Llama-style baseline at equal active params
metric: Val loss at fixed FLOPs, tokens/s, KV cache per token, expert load balance, grad-norm stability
deliverable: Public repo + paper-style write-up: 'Which DeepSeek ideas still help at 1B scale?' Negative results reported honestly
roles: Pretraining / architecture research engineer at every lab; strong Anthropic Fellows research artifact
upstream: Share the ablation results with the authors' repos / community; PR fixes to any reference code you used

name: Safety research: agent monitoring + interpretability
bar: An AI-control style eval: coding agents in OperatorOK sandboxes attempt covert side tasks; compare monitor protocols (trusted LLM monitor, SAE-feature probe) with catch rate vs false-positive rate, 3+ models
deliverable: Paper-style write-up on arXiv or LessWrong/Alignment Forum + open-source eval (Inspect)
roles: Anthropic Fellows, Anthropic/OpenAI safety research engineer, Redwood, METR, UK AISI

name: Low-precision: int4/fp8 quantization with kernels
bar: GPTQ + AWQ from scratch; a W4A16 Triton matmul kernel; perplexity within 2% of bf16 on a 7B-class model; speedup measured end to end in featherserve

name: Open-source track record
bar: 5+ merged PRs across PyTorch, Triton, vLLM, SGLang, TRL, torchtitan, TransformerLens by the end of the roadmap
deliverable: A 'Contributions' section on the resume and harikanth.site
roles: Every lab. Merged PRs to the infrastructure they run are the strongest signal for a non-traditional candidate.
upstream: Start with 'good first issue' labels, then fix things you hit while building P1-P7
